knowledge_cards.why: Filament widget/table traps: deferLoading hides rows from HTTP checks (verify card values in a browser or in-process, not curl); asserting a config is not asserting it renders.

Local test-run traps: full suite needs php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpunit (artisan test OOMs at exit 0); RequiresClickhouse truncates LITERAL clarity/zod, so local CH DBs must use those names; CLICKHOUSE_DRIVER=pgsql silently skips every CH test.
Cross-app CH rules: PG is source of truth and CH lags via CDC; bounded time ranges + indexed filters + deterministic ORDER BY; purge/cleanup classes are blast-radius.
